BiblicalUsage: The word is a jurisdiction, a dominion, and it appears once, when God asks Job whether he knows the ordinances of heaven and can set their dominion in the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the question settles it: the heavens have a government, and it is not mine to set.
